alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A kitchen. Two small block figures with white eyes, an ink-black one on the left and a brick-red one on the right, and a small yellow card on the floor between them. The black one says I got it! and the card slides toward it. The red one says no, I got it! and the card slides to the red one. They trade my treat! and you get next one, and finally the black one says deal! with a happy pulse as the card settles in the middle where it started, so the film repeats without a cut. The text stays: me and my friend and the check.
